A Pokémon composed of ancient, crumbling stone and clay, appearing as a floating, jagged mass of rock. Its body is a dusty, ochre-brown color with glowing, ethereal purple runes etched across its surface. It has two small, glowing yellow eyes. It possesses no traditional tail or wings. It has three rocky protrusions acting as fingers on each hand.
BODY COLOR: ochre-brown
